conditions: Identical task, model, effort, tools, execution boundary and time cap. Fabius arm alone receives pinned contract text and corresponding reference files. Extra instruction/input-token cost is part of treatment and reported. Independent fresh run for every arm/repetition. Generation order counterbalanced by repetition.
scoring: Freeze independent math and browser oracles before scoring. Group by meaningful acceptance criteria. Report both repeats, all failures and raw observed outcomes; no cherry-picking, no hidden repair. Blind proof/design reviews are qualitative and separately identified. No overall percentage improvement or statistical significance claim from three tasks.
timeouts: Preserve and grade existing artifact; report timeout/incomplete. Rerun only a demonstrated harness/setup failure, recording all attempts. No rerun just because an artifact loses.
lessons: Freeze measured artifacts before deriving lessons. Any subsequent Fabius changes are outside this measured snapshot and cannot inherit these scores.
publication: All 12 source artifacts, task briefs, contract hashes, check results and limitations are available. Publish screenshots from actual artifacts and native animations over those screenshots/data; never fabricate product UI or claim frames are an actual execution recording.
isolation_status: Passed positive/negative model-visible input preflight; per-run input checks required before generation.
browser_environment: Both arms receive a parent-managed isolated Chrome CDP endpoint and static HTTP server on localhost. Workspace network access is enabled for these; external service use is forbidden by the common instructions, and web/apps/MCP tools are disabled.
execution_boundary: Existing account, no HOME/config mutation. One external macOS read-denial policy for CLI, Chrome and HTTP; native tool sandbox disabled to prevent unsupported nesting. No approvals. Selected sources/records/oracles blocked; allowed-resource restrictions also exist in shared instructions. Not an audited general-purpose security sandbox.

pre_generation_amendments.reason: Both first processes rejected the empty-config MCP transport before any model call. Debug must disable configured MCP entries; exec with --ignore-user-config must omit those entries entirely.

Two actual model starts had all file/shell tools fail because macOS cannot nest Seatbelt. Neither produced artifact files. Both aborted and retained. Use one external sandbox; native tool sandbox and Chrome internal sandbox disabled under that external policy. Parent Chrome/HTTP now share read-denial.
